title: Change the dashboard date range
blurb: See this week, last month or any custom period.

steps.title: Open the date picker
steps.body: Click the date range at the top of the dashboard.

steps.title: Choose your period
steps.body: Pick a preset like this week or last month, or click a start and end date on the calendar for a custom range.

steps.title: Read the results
steps.body: Every widget updates to the new dates. Your choice is saved for you only, so teammates keep their own view.
